llm_response.reason: The website ninewest.com.mx closely mimics the branding and product catalogue of the official Nine West brand, but the domain was registered very recently by an individual in Germany, not by the official brand or its authorized distributors. In top search results, the legitimate Mexican Nine West site is 'ninewestmexico.com', and the queried site is absent from official listings. This pattern is indicative of a scam website impersonating the real Nine West to deceive shoppers and collect payments or personal data. Hallmarks of scam sites present: brand impersonation, registration by unrelated international parties, very recent domain creation, and nonappearance in legitimate channels.
